updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Content Preview in Alerts
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now allows users with appropriate permissions to preview file content directly within IRM alerts without creating a case, streamlining investigation workflows. This reduces friction in responding to insider risk signals and accelerates threat assessment.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Adaptive Scopes for SharePoint
updates.summary: DLP now supports dynamic adaptive scopes for SharePoint that automatically target policies based on site attributes like URL, name, or metadata, eliminating the 100-site static limit and reducing manual maintenance. Admins can now deploy policies at scale with continuous auto-evaluation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager – AI Foundry Integration
updates.summary: Compliance Manager now integrates with Microsoft AI Foundry to automatically map AI agents to compliance regulations and evaluate their control posture. Organizations can track compliance status of AI systems and identify improvement actions in a unified interface.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager – AI-Powered Regulatory Templates
updates.summary: Compliance Manager can now convert complex regulatory documents in PDF format into actionable controls and compliance assessments across multi-cloud environments using AI. This accelerates the process of understanding regulatory requirements and identifying compliance gaps.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Faster Policy Sync (30 Minutes)
updates.summary: DLP policy synchronization time has been reduced from 2 hours to 30 minutes, ensuring protection rules take effect more quickly across the organization. This improvement tightens the window between policy updates and enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure retention policies in SharePoint Online to archive inactive files to low-cost storage, complementing keep and delete actions. This provides cost-effective compliance while maintaining discoverability of archived content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Tips Support in Outlook for Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips now extend to Outlook for Mac, providing real-time in-mail notifications when messages contain sensitive data that violates policies. Users can remove non-compliant recipients or request policy override directly from the mail tip.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Tips Support in Outlook Mobile
updates.summary: Outlook Mobile now includes real-time DLP policy tip alerts to help users avoid sending sensitive information that violates organizational policies. This extends compliance protection to mobile email scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Endpoint DLP Alert Analysis
updates.summary: Data Security Investigations can now be launched directly from endpoint DLP alerts to automatically gather and analyze files that triggered alerts, filtering by time, user, and endpoint. This accelerates investigation and remediation of potential exfiltration incidents.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure retention policies for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory items stored in Exchange mailboxes, preserving historical versions for security and compliance investigations. This provides governance over AI-generated interaction history.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP – Protect Sensitive Data from Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from sending sensitive data to external web search, controlling what information is exposed during AI-powered search interactions. This mitigates oversharing risks in generative AI scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management now provides hard delete capability through secure priority cleanup workflows for OneDrive and SharePoint, allowing permanent removal of content beyond the standard 93-day recycle bin retention. This helps organizations meet strict data destruction compliance requirements while maintaining safeguards against misconfigured policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP policies now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications like Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and classification engines. This extends data protection governance beyond the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels – Auto-Labeling Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled without applying changes, allowing admins to review match results and distribution before enforcement. This reduces risk of incorrect label application at scale.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels – Policy Insights Dashboard
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policy details now include an Insights tab showing at-a-glance performance metrics, with different views for simulation versus enforcement mode. This helps admins understand classification effectiveness and optimize policy configuration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now classify and label sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft apps including Box and Google Workspace using Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This unifies sensitivity label enforcement across hybrid environments.
